description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions related to Visual Studio configuration, including parsing compiler and linker options, and generating GUIDs based on input strings.

classes.name: CompilerOptions
classes.description: Holds compiler configuration options with default constructor and destructor.

classes.name: LinkerOptions
classes.description: Holds linker configuration options with default constructor and destructor.

methods.name: MakeGuid
methods.description: Generates a GUID string based on an entry path and seed using MD5 hashing.

methods.name: ParseCompilerOption
methods.description: Parses a compiler flag string and updates the CompilerOptions object accordingly.

methods.name: ParseLinkerOption
methods.description: Parses a linker flag string and updates the LinkerOptions object accordingly.
